respawnSeconds.description: Wait before respawn: Seconds a downed player waits before the hospital option appears.

respawnFee.description: Hospital fee: Taken when waking up at the hospital; players who cannot pay go free.

accounts.description: Paid from: Money accounts tried in order.

clearInventory.description: Lose items: Waking up at the hospital empties the inventory.

emsJobs.description: Medic jobs: On-duty members of these jobs revive with a medikit and get the doctor calls.

treatPrice.description: Treatment price: Check-in treatment heals fully for this price.

treatMaxEms.description: Medics for check-in: Check-in works only while at most this many medics are on duty.

healthRegen.description: Health refills by itself: GTA slowly gives back health (up to half) when you are not hurt for a while. Off: only healing, medics and items give health.

reviveFee.description: Revive fee: A medic's medikit revive sends the revived player a bill from the medic's job; the job's account gets it when they pay. 0 = free.

distressCooldown.description: Doctor call wait: Seconds a downed player waits between two doctor calls.
